Mei: quick note — seeing a one-bit KV key diff after long prefill on orpheus-16k int4; occurs around 16k tokens when RoPE wraps. Repro short:
```bash
./infer --model orpheus-16k/int4 --prompt long_seed_30k.txt --seed 11 --dump-kv /tmp/kv.bin --shadow
```
Carlos: any hexdump? sounds like LSB flip from rotary rounding.
Mei: hexdiff snippet (host vs shadow) around slot 16384:
```
# host: .. 33 7a 01 00 11 22
# shadow: .. 33 7b 01 00 11 22
```
Ana: try forcing prefill keys to int8 and rerun; also test KV_SLOT_MASK=0x1FFF to make slot mapping deterministic.
Mei: ran 300 runs locally: baseline 8/300, int8-prefill 2/300, mask+int8 0/300.
infra-bot: scheduled eng-ml canary with KV_SLOT_MASK=0x1FFF and INT8_PREFILL=1 for 500 long-prefill traces at 02:00 UTC.
Carlos: good signal. plan: land opt-in mask + int8 prefill as short-term mitigation, follow with accumulator precision PR to fix rotary quant rounding. will add smoke metric: ropemismatch-rate per 1k traces.
Mei: filing phab D40001 and adding a small runbook entry under eng-ml/playbooks/bringup.md with repro steps and hexdiff examples. Thanks!
